description: ristretto deterministic gates: per-file format after Write/Edit (never blocks), full lint+typecheck+test gate on Stop and SubagentStop while a pull is active (blocks with exit 2). SubagentStop gates brew's per-feature subagents individually. Hangs are detected by output silence (per-gate budgets in .ristretto.json), not by total runtime, so a slow-but-working suite is never killed. The hook timeouts below are only an outer backstop for the pathological case; they must stay well above any real gate run, or a working suite is killed before it can report.
